name: Grade 8 IT Practice: March Week 3 - Campaign Graphics
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: A planned message that asks people to care or act.
words.example: The campaign asked students to keep devices organized and safe.

words.definition: The group the campaign graphic is made to inform or persuade.
words.example: The audience for the poster was Grade 8 students.
The message told viewers to back up their portfolio files.

words.definition: A small picture that represents an idea.
words.example: The icon showed a small shield for online safety.

words.definition: A symbol or design that represents a group or idea.
words.example: The logo used simple shapes so it stayed clear when small.

words.definition: Making work that is your own idea.
words.example: Originality meant drawing a new symbol instead of copying one.
The sketch planned the poster layout before the final design.
